verses.author: model_A
verses.text: She folds the letter twice before deciding not to send it.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the drawer sticks
where she keeps all the words
she almost gave away

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
dust settles on the ink
even silence learns
to keep its shape

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the kettle waits too
she forgets it's on the stove
until it forgets to sing

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a moth taps the window
looking for the light
she turned off years ago

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
morning finds the cup
still holding yesterday's warmth
she drinks it anyway

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a calendar page
curls at the corner
no one turns it anymore

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
dust settles on the frame
where a face used to smile
the wall remembers better than we do

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
footsteps by the door
pause, then choose the stairs instead
the porch light stays on all night

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the phone still saves her number
under a name no one else uses now
static answers on the third ring

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a moth circles the porch light
mistaking it for something warm
morning finds it on the sill, still

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
someone sweeps the sill clean
before the coffee's even poured
grief needs a morning chore

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the number's dialed by habit
before the second ring, she remembers
sets the phone face-down, softly

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the dust waits where the moth was
she wipes it up without looking
starts the coffee anyway

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
steam rises where no one sits
she pours a second cup from habit
lets it go cold by the window

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the window fogs from the cold cup's steam
someone writes a name in it
lets the morning erase it
